name: Partiality
overview: Scripture clearly condemns partiality, emphasizing that God does not show favoritism and expects His people to judge righteously without respect to persons, whether poor or mighty. Partiality among brethren, such as a father's overt love for one child over others, leads to hatred and division, as seen in the example of Joseph and his brothers. God's justice demands impartiality in judgment, warning against transgressing righteousness for personal gain. The biblical standard calls believers to uphold fairness and resist favoritism in all relationships.
